tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Primary brand green. Buttons, headings, links, the logo. White or cream text on it passes 7:1.

tokens.name: forest-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed states, big banners, slide backgrounds. Cream text on it passes 10:1.

tokens.name: forest-tint
tokens.usage: Soft panels, callout backgrounds, table header rows. Use forest-deep or ink text on it.

tokens.name: sunshine
tokens.usage: Accent: highlights, badges, the logo crumb, slide accents. Never as text on cream or white (1.3:1). Ink or forest-deep text on it passes 9:1+.

tokens.name: sunshine-soft
tokens.usage: Tip boxes and 'try it' callouts on worksheets. Ink text only.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Default page, slide and handout background. Warmer than white and easier on aging eyes.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Cards and printed worksheet areas that need to sit above cream.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text. 14:1 on cream.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions. 6:1 on cream. Never go lighter.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card borders on cream. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of an input.

tokens.name: brick
tokens.usage: Warnings and errors, always with an icon and words. 5.9:1 on cream.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 3px, 2px offset. The only blue in the system.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels and slides. Matches the logo's soft corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges.
